controls.name: context-ignored
controls.find: pub open spec fn effective_graph(ctx: Option<G>, arg: G) -> G { match ctx { Some(g) => g, None => arg } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn effective_graph(ctx: Option<G>, arg: G) -> G { arg }
controls.classification: decision: the argument overrides a quad's context

controls.name: keep-datatype
controls.find: pub open spec fn stored_has_datatype(l: Lit) -> bool { false }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn stored_has_datatype(l: Lit) -> bool { l.dt != Dt::Plain }
controls.classification: effect: the stored row keeps the datatype (the repair)

controls.name: upsert-property
controls.find: pub open spec fn after_import(cur: Option<int>, v: int) -> Option<int> { match cur { Some(c) => Some(c), None => Some(v) } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn after_import(cur: Option<int>, v: int) -> Option<int> { Some(v) }
controls.classification: effect: a re-import replaces the value (the repair)

controls.name: full-iri-key
controls.find: pub open spec fn key_of(namespace: int, local: int) -> int { local }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn key_of(namespace: int, local: int) -> int { namespace }
controls.classification: decision: the key includes the namespace

controls.name: infer-on-contexts
controls.find: pub open spec fn infer_graph(arg: G, quads_ctx: Option<G>) -> G { arg }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn infer_graph(arg: G, quads_ctx: Option<G>) -> G { match quads_ctx { Some(g) => g, None => arg } }
controls.classification: decision: inference runs where the quads went (the repair)
